method: Continuous source-art mesh with separate trouser-leg displacement, sleeve reach, chest breathing, head nod and cap droop. Original snore wisp stretches locally. No unpainted anatomy or replacement face; unlettered sleeper reflected left.

actions.idle: Gentle chest breath, tiny head nod and lagged cap droop; feet stay still.
actions.attack: Cap droops, forward foot lifts into one careful leftward half-step, sleeves reach and a snore expands; feet and body recover.
actions.hurt: Rightward flinch, sleeve withdrawal and knees bracing, followed by recovery.
actions.defeat: Knees soften and head/cap droop into sleep as the translucent sleeper fades completely.

orientation.method: Reflected nose, closed-eye profile, reaching hands, toes and connected snore face left. Half-step travels left and hurt recoils right. No letters or handed props reversed.
